item.title: Nvidia finds that simple linear math can replace costly AI model handoffs
item.description: When an agentic AI system hands a task from a small model to a larger one — or back down again — it pays a steep tax: the receiving model has to recompute the entire conversation from scratch, driving up compute costs and latency. This is a major bottleneck for enterprises building long-horizon, multi-LLM workflows.To solve this challenge, researchers at Nvidia have introduced a cross-model KV cache transfer technique that directly maps the prefilled KV cache from a source model into the target model. This technique aligns with real-world agentic applications where large contexts accumulate ac...
